items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: Well, as I have foresaid, in the eight piece band we had Elvis Russo.

ctx.x: I was thinking trombones after Ridgely left. Do you remember who the trombones were?
Well, as I have foresaid, in the eight piece band we had Elvis Russo.
Oh, yes. Oh, that's right, sure.

items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: August Russel was a trombone player whom I was trying to remember as being a part of the early band when I first joined.

ctx.x: And did you know August Russel? Russel?
August Russel was a trombone player whom I was trying to remember as being a part of the early band when I first joined. He was a trombone at that time. August Russel, yeah.
And what about the cornet player, Russelistan? Who was playing the second cornet?
